sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 690.3 ± 80.4 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by anti-HA detection in SBA; MRGPRX4–RAMP protein complexes detected, demonstrating the tagged receptor is expressed and capable of forming functional protein–protein interactions with RAMPs.
sites.rationale: MRGPRX4 has no signal peptide (topology string contains no 'S'; residues 1–29 are extracellular 'O'). The N-terminal tail is the sole extracellular terminus, so the HA tag prepends before M1 (insert_after_residue=0). The 29-residue extracellular N-terminus provides ample distance (≥3 aa) from TM1 at residue 30. L3 and L4 confirm surface expression and RAMP-interaction function of this exact construct, making this the best-validated site in the ledger. Full-length HA-MRGPRX4-1D4 expressed in Freestyle 293 cells; HA epitope on the N-terminal tail, 1D4 epitope on the C-terminal tail. MRGPRX4 has no endogenous signal peptide (topology residues 1–29 are directly extracellular), so the N-terminal HA tag prepends before M1. The construct was used in a multiplexed suspension bead array (SBA) with anti-HA and anti-1D4 mAbs to detect MRGPRX4–RAMP complexes.

sources.claim: A , MRGPRX4 was tagged at its N-terminal and C-terminal tail with HA and 1D4 mAb epitopes, respectively.

Genes for human MRGPRX2 (UniProtKB- Q96LB1 ) and human MRGPRX4 (UniProtKB- Q96LA9 ) were individually cloned into a modified pFastBac1 vector which contains a hemagglutinin (HA) signal peptide followed by FLAG-tag, His10-tag, and a TEV protease site at the N terminus.

literature_notes: All four ledger lines concern the extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–29) or the intracellular C-terminus (residues 276–322) of MRGPRX4. No ledger line reports a tag insertion in any extracellular loop (ECL1 82–96, ECL2 159–177, ECL3 242–252). L1 and L2/L3/L4 both pin the same junction (prepend before M1) but via different constructs and tags; both are reported as required. The C-terminal 1D4 tag from L2 is intracellular and placed in other_positions. No ledger line names a specific residue number for any insertion, so all positions are topology_derived (sole extracellular terminus). L3 and L4 are additional validations of the L2 construct and do not introduce new sites.

literature_other_positions.note: 1D4 epitope tag placed on the C-terminal tail of MRGPRX4 in the HA-MRGPRX4-1D4 construct; the C-terminus (residues 276–322) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this is not a surface tag site.
